title: BGISEQ-500 Sequencing
author: Jie Huang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.pq7dmzn
materials: Sequencing is initiated after the sequencing reagents preloaded and sequencing chip was installed, and this process is finished in about 72 hours. When the whole sequencing was finished, the binary file with bases and quality score were converted into FASTQ format with Phred+33 quality score.

steps.title: Assess library quality
steps.instruction: Measure the sequencing library using the Qubit® ssDNA Assay Kit, using a total of 6 ng of sample.

steps.title: Perform rolling circle amplification
steps.instruction: Set up an 80 µL RCA reaction containing pure water, appropriate buffer, and DNB polymerase, and incubate for 10 minutes (00:10:00).

steps.title: Stop RCA reaction
steps.instruction: Add 20 µL DNBs stopping buffer to the RCA mixture to terminate the reaction.

steps.title: Assess DNB concentration
steps.instruction: Quantify the DNB product with the Qubit® ssDNA Assay Kit; the concentration must be ≥10 ng/µL.

steps.title: Transfer chip to sequencer
steps.instruction: After loading, remove the chip and install it into the BGISEQ‑500 sequencing instrument.
